rows_data = cells('Allowed assignments', 'L812:N820')
tasks = list(set(r[0] for r in rows_data))
workers = list(set(r[1] for r in rows_data))
costs = {(r[0], r[1]): r[2] for r in rows_data}
# Dune is unavailable
avail_workers = [w for w in workers if w != 'Dune']
# Find minimum cost matching all tasks (Inspect, Pack, Polish) to available workers
import itertools
min_cost = float('inf')
for p in itertools.permutations(avail_workers, len(tasks)):
    mapping = dict(zip(tasks, p))
    cost = sum(costs.get((t, w), float('inf')) for t, w in mapping.items())
    if cost < min_cost:
        min_cost = cost
result = int(min_cost)
assumptions: Dune is excluded, workers can perform at most one task, each task needs one worker.
